title: Design and synthesis of stilbene analogs based on resveratrol as NF-kappaB inhibitors for the treatment of breast cancer.
authors: Fu, Shaojuan; Zhang, Yu; Yang, Yuanli; Lu, Xing; Wang, Yanni; Lei, Lingling; Lan, Junjie; He, Huan; Zhang, Silong; Pan, Weidong
one_liner_zh: 该文设计白藜芦醇类似物作为NF-kappaB抑制剂用于乳腺癌治疗，虽涉及NF-kappaB p65蛋白的分子对接，但核心是药物化学与信号通路抑制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究，方法仅简单对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: NF-kappaB is a critical signaling molecule connecting inflammation and tumors, involved in numerous cellular processes, including inflammation, cell transformation, tumor cell survival, proliferation, invasion, angiogenesis, and metastasis by regulating immune, growth, and inflammatory gene expression. Inhibition of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway in tumor cells can effectively reduce inflammation levels, potentially providing antitumor benefits. Resveratrol, a natural polyphenolic compound known for its anti-inflammatory properties, has been shown both anti-inflammatory and anticancer effects in breast cancer cells through the inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling. Based on the stilbene structure of Resveratrol, we designed and synthesized a series of novel analogs. Preliminary screening indicated that compound 8a exhibited not only anti-inflammatory and antiproliferative effects but also suppressant on the expression of inflammatory factors in MCF-7 breast cancer cells. To gain a deeper understanding of its mechanism of action, we further investigated the inhibitory effect of compound 8a on the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. The study found that compound 8a can significantly reduce the expression levels of key proteins p65 and IkappaBalpha in the classical NF-kappaB signaling pathway and effectively prevent the entry of p65 protein into the nucleus, thereby exhibiting potent anti-inflammatory effects and potential anti-breast cancer activity. Molecular docking analysis results show that compound 8a interacts with the NF-kappaB p65 protein through two crucial hydrogen bonds, and this binding affinity is even superior to that of the known Resveratrol. In summary, compound 8a could be a promising drug lead, as a NF-kappaB inhibitor for breast cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: NF-kappaB是连接炎症与肿瘤的关键信号分子，通过调控免疫、生长和炎症基因表达，参与包括炎症、细胞转化、肿瘤细胞存活、增殖、侵袭、血管生成和转移在内的多种细胞过程。抑制肿瘤细胞中的NF-kappaB信号通路可有效降低炎症水平，可能提供抗肿瘤益处。白藜芦醇（Resveratrol）是一种具有抗炎特性的天然多酚类化合物，已显示通过抑制NF-kappaB信号在乳腺癌细胞中发挥抗炎和抗癌作用。基于白藜芦醇的芪类结构，我们设计并合成了一系列新型类似物。初步筛选表明，化合物8a不仅具有抗炎和抗增殖作用，还能抑制MCF-7乳腺癌细胞中炎症因子的表达。为更深入理解其作用机制，我们进一步研究了化合物8a对NF-kappaB信号通路的抑制作用。研究发现，化合物8a能显著降低经典NF-kappaB信号通路中关键蛋白p65和IkappaBalpha的表达水平，并有效阻止p65蛋白进入细胞核，从而表现出强效抗炎活性和潜在的抗乳腺癌活性。分子对接分析结果显示，化合物8a通过两个关键氢键与NF-kappaB p65蛋白相互作用，且其结合亲和力甚至优于已知的白藜芦醇。总之，化合物8a可能作为一种有前景的药物先导物，作为NF-kappaB抑制剂用于乳腺癌治疗。
